about: Mara walks the length of North Quay with the harbour master, Ines Okafor, and asks what the new tide gate will change for the boats that land there. The gate cost 4 million dollars and took three years to build. Ines Okafor explains why it closes only on spring tides, and why the Northwind Cooperative asked for it.
